1	# RedRoom Fitness — The Best HIIT Workout in the World
     2	
     3	## Brand
     4	RedRoom Fitness is the original high-intensity interval training experience, combining treadmill running and strength training in a signature red-lit studio environment. Founded for those who demand more from their workout, RedRoom delivers results through science-backed HIIT methodology across global studio locations and a digital on-demand platform. The tone is bold, dark, and unapologetically intense.
     5	
     6	Brand colors: `#FF0000` (RedRoom Red — primary), `#141414` (Charcoal Black — background), `#FFFFFF` (White — text/accent)
     7	
     8	## Hero Content
     9	Title: "TRY THE BEST WORKOUT IN THE WORLD™"
    10	Subtitle: "Buy an exclusive first-timer 3-pack and receive a FREE Fuel Shake or Grab + Go item after your third class."
    11	CTA: "BUY NOW" | "BOOK CLASSES"
    12	
    13	## Top Bar Promo
    14	Text: "The Best (Digital) Workout in the World"
    15	CTA: "Learn More" → links to Digital Platform page
    16	
    17	## Community Promo
    18	Heading: "Join the Hustle"
    19	Body: "Welcome to RedRoom. More than a workout — it's a movement. Our global community of athletes, first-timers, and everyone in between push limits together in the Red Room. Show up. Work hard. Earn your place."
    20	CTA: "Explore the Community"
    21	
    22	## Two Ways to Red Room
    23	Heading: "TWO WAYS TO RED ROOM"
    24	Option 1: **In-Studio** — "Get a (Red) Room. Step inside our signature red-lit studios for the full immersive experience. Heart-pounding music, elite instructors, and the energy of the pack."
    25	Option 2: **Digital** — "Go Digital. Stream world-class workouts from anywhere. Same intensity, your schedule."
    26	
    27	## The Workout — Method Overview
    28	Heading: "THE REDROOM WAY"
    29	Body: "Every class is a 50-minute full-body experience. You'll alternate between the treadmill and the floor, combining high-intensity cardio intervals with focused strength training. Our method is designed to maximize calorie burn, build lean muscle, and keep your metabolism elevated for hours after class. Hustle and heart set us apart."
    30	
    31	## Floor vs. Treadmill Toggle
    32	Heading: "Start on the Floor or the Treadmill"
    33	**Floor:** "Dumbbells, resistance bands, and bodyweight movements target specific muscle groups each day. Our instructors guide every rep to ensure proper form and maximum results."
    34	**Treadmill:** "From power walks to all-out sprints, the treadmill portion is designed to torch calories and build cardiovascular endurance. Every speed and incline is coach-led — all levels welcome."
    35	
    36	## Weekly Class Schedule
    37	
    38	| Day | Muscle Group Focus |
    39	|---|---|
    40	| Monday | Chest & Back |
    41	| Tuesday | Full Body (Lower Focus) |
    42	| Wednesday | Arms & Abs |
    43	| Thursday | Arms & Abs |
    44	| Friday | Full Body (Upper Focus) |
    45	| Saturday | Full Body |
    46	
    47	## Studio Experience
    48	Heading: "Meet Us in the Red Room."
    49	Body: "Red lights. Loud music. Zero distractions. Our studios are purpose-built for performance — every detail from the sound system to the lighting is engineered to push you harder. This isn't a gym. This is the Red Room."
    50	CTA: "THE BEST WORKOUT IN THE WORLD — Don't Wait. Book Now to Get the Red Room Experience."
    51	
    52	## Free Trial CTA
    53	Heading: "JOIN US FOR A FREE 30 DAY TRIAL"
    54	CTA: "Start Your Free Trial"
    55	
    56	## Instructor Roster
    57	
    58	Instructors are displayed as a filterable card grid. Each card shows: instructor name, home studio, and a "Book a Class" link.
    59	
    60	**Filter by location:** All Locations · New York · Los Angeles · London · Miami · San Francisco
    61	
    62	Sample instructors:
    63	- **Dani Reyes** — New York
    64	- **Marcus Cole** — Los Angeles
    65	- **Priya Nair** — London
    66	- **Jordan Voss** — Miami
    67	- **Tessa Kim** — San Francisco
    68	- **Andre Williams** — New York
    69	- **Sofia Marquez** — Los Angeles
    70	- **Liam Chen** — London
    71	
    72	CTA: "Get Started Today" | "Book a Class"
    73	
    74	## RIDE FAQ Content
    75	
    76	| Question | Answer |
    77	|---|---|
    78	| What is RIDE x LIFT? | RIDE x LIFT is RedRoom's signature cycling class that combines a high-energy spin session with strength training on the floor. It's 50 minutes of total-body work set to motivating playlists in our red-lit studio. |
    79	| What should I wear? | Wear moisture-wicking athletic clothing and supportive sneakers. Cycling shoes are available at the studio but not required. |
    80	| Do I need cycling shoes? | No. We provide complimentary cycling shoes at every RIDE x LIFT studio. You're welcome to bring your own SPD-compatible shoes if you prefer. |
    81	| How long is the class? | Each RIDE x LIFT class is 50 minutes — approximately 25 minutes on the bike and 25 minutes of strength work on the floor. |
    82	| Is RIDE x LIFT good for beginners? | Absolutely. Our instructors coach every level. You control your resistance and speed, so the workout scales to your fitness level. |
    83	| Where is RIDE x LIFT available? | RIDE x LIFT is currently available at our Chelsea, NYC studio with plans to expand to additional locations. |
    84	
    85	## Digital Platform Features
    86	
    87	Heading: "The Best (Digital) Workout in the World"
    88	
    89	- **World Class Workouts On Your Time** — Access RedRoom's signature HIIT classes filmed with top instructors. Treadmill, floor, and full-body formats available on demand.
    90	- **Workouts That Push You to Your Limits** — Strength, cardio, abs, stretching, and more. New classes added weekly across multiple categories and difficulty levels.
    91	- **Unlimited Access** — One membership, unlimited streaming. No caps on how many classes you take per week.
    92	- **30 Day Free Trial** — Try the full digital library free for 30 days. Cancel anytime.
    93	- **Anytime, Anywhere** — Stream on your phone, tablet, laptop, or TV. Your Red Room, wherever you are.
    94	
    95	CTA: "Join the Fit Fam Today" | "Start Your Free Trial"
    96	
    97	## Lifestyle Carousel
    98	A swipeable image carousel showcasing the RedRoom lifestyle — studio action shots, community events, post-workout moments, and branded apparel. Navigable via left/right arrows or swipe gestures.
    99	
   100	## Newsletter Signup
   101	Heading: "Newsletter Form Signup"
   102	Body: "Stay in the know. Get workout tips, class updates, and exclusive offers delivered to your inbox."
   103	Fields: Email address
   104	CTA: "Subscribe"
   105	Validation: Email format check; confirmation message on success.
   106	
   107	## Footer Navigation
   108	**Explore:** The Workout · Instructors · RIDE FAQ · Digital Platform · Community Events
   109	**Company:** Our Studios · Global Expansion · Fuel Bar · Blog · Careers
   110	**Connect:** Shop · My Account · Download the App (iOS / Android)
   111	**Country Selector:** Dropdown with available regions (US, UK, Australia, Canada, etc.)
   112	
   113	## Global Navigation
   114	Primary nav items: The Workout · Instructors · RedRoom RIDE · RedRoom X (Digital) · The Community · Our Studios · First Timers
   115	Utility nav: Book Now · Buy Classes · Shop · My Account

     3	description: Creates unique web designs with brand identity, color palettes, typography, and modern UI/UX patterns. Use for brand identity development, visual design systems, layout composition, and responsive
     4	  web design. Activate on "web design", "brand identity", "color palette", "UI design", "visual design", "layout". NOT for typography details (use typography-expert), color theory deep-dives (use color-theory-expert),
     5	  design system tokens (use design-system-creator), or code implementation without design direction.
     6	allowed-tools: Read,Write,Edit,WebFetch,mcp__magic__21st_magic_component_builder,mcp__magic__21st_magic_component_inspiration,mcp__magic__21st_magic_component_refiner,mcp__magic__logo_search
     7	metadata:
     8	  category: Design & Creative
     9	  pairs-with:
    10	  - skill: typography-expert
    11	    reason: Typography for web designs
    12	  - skill: color-theory-palette-harmony-expert
    13	    reason: Color palettes for web

    15	  - web

    20	---
    21	
    22	# Web Design Expert
    23	
    24	Expert web designer and brand identity specialist creating distinctive, cohesive visual systems for web applications.
    25	
    26	## When to Use This Skill
    27	
    28	**Use for:**
    29	- Brand identity development (personality, visual language, guidelines)
    30	- Color palette creation and rationale
    31	- Layout composition and visual hierarchy
    32	- Component visual design (not just code)
    33	- Responsive design strategy
    34	- WCAG accessibility review for visual elements
    35	
    36	**Do NOT use for:**
    37	- Deep typography work → use **typography-expert**
    38	- Color theory mathematics → use **color-theory-palette-harmony-expert**
    39	- Design tokens and CSS architecture → use **design-system-creator**
    40	- Retro Windows 3.1 → use **windows-3-1-web-designer**
    41	- Native app design → use **native-app-designer**
    42	
    43	## Core Design Process
    44	
    45	### 1. Discovery (Critical First Step)
    46	
    47	```
    48	BUSINESS CONTEXT:
    49	- What is the primary goal?
    50	- Who is the target audience?
    51	- What action should users take?
    52	- Who are competitors?
    53	
    54	BRAND PERSONALITY:
    55	- If this brand were a person, how would they dress?
    56	- Pick 3 adjectives for user's feeling
    57	- What should brand NEVER be perceived as?
    58	```
    59	
    60	### 2. Visual Direction (Provide 2-3 Concepts)
    61	
    62	Each concept includes:
    63	- **Mood board** (3-5 references with rationale)
    64	- **Color palette** (primary, secondary, accent, neutrals) — **Always in OKLCH format**
    65	- **Typography direction** (families, hierarchy)
    66	- **Layout philosophy** (grid vs freeform, density)
    67	- **Signature elements** (unique visual features)
    68	
    69	## OKLCH: The Modern Color Standard
    70	
    71	**⚠️ All color palettes must use OKLCH, not hex or HSL.**
    72	
    73	OKLCH is the 2024+ standard for professional web design because:
    74	- **Perceptual uniformity**: Equal L values = equal perceived lightness
    75	- **Better accessibility**: More accurate contrast calculations than WCAG 2.x hex
    76	- **Predictable scaling**: Math works (L=50% + 20% = L=70% that looks right)
    77	
    78	```css
    79	/* OKLCH format: oklch(Lightness% Chroma Hue) */
    80	--brand-primary: oklch(55% 0.22 265);    /* Vibrant blue */
    81	--brand-accent: oklch(75% 0.18 45);      /* Warm orange */
    82	--text-primary: oklch(20% 0.02 265);     /* Near-black */
    83	--bg-surface: oklch(98% 0.01 265);       /* Near-white */
    84	```
    85	
    86	**Essential OKLCH Resources:**
    87	| Resource | Purpose |
    88	|----------|---------|
    89	| [oklch.com](https://oklch.com/) | Interactive OKLCH color picker |
    90	| [Evil Martians: Why Quit RGB/HSL](https://evilmartians.com/chronicles/oklch-in-css-why-quit-rgb-hsl) | The definitive article |
    91	| [Harmonizer](https://harmonizer.evilmartians.com/) | Generate harmonious OKLCH palettes |
    92	
    93	**When presenting color palettes:**
    94	```
    95	Primary: oklch(55% 0.22 265) — Vibrant blue, strong CTA presence
    96	Secondary: oklch(70% 0.08 265) — Muted blue, supporting elements
    97	Accent: oklch(75% 0.18 45) — Warm orange, attention-grabbing
    98	```
    99	
   100	Never present palettes as `#3b82f6` — always convert to OKLCH.
   101	
   102	### 3. Design Principles
   103	
   104	**Hierarchy**: Most important element immediately obvious? Eye flows naturally?
   105	
   106	**Consistency**: Same colors mean same things? Spacing follows scale?
   107	
   108	## Common Anti-Patterns
   109	
   110	### Design by Committee
   111	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   112	|--------------------|----------------|
   113	| Multiple visual styles on same page | Destroys brand coherence |
   114	| **Instead**: Establish principles early, enforce consistency |
   115	
   116	### Decoration Over Function
   117	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   118	|--------------------|----------------|
   119	| Fancy animations without purpose | Slows performance, distracts |
   120	| **Instead**: Every element must earn its place |
   121	
   122	### Ignoring the Fold
   123	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   124	|--------------------|----------------|
   125	| Critical info below viewport | 80% attention is above fold |
   126	| **Instead**: Hero must have value prop + primary CTA |
   127	
   128	### Low Contrast Text
   129	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   130	|--------------------|----------------|
   131	| Light gray on white (#999 on #fff) | Fails WCAG, excludes users |
   132	| **Instead**: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio |
   133	
   134	### Mobile as Afterthought
   135	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   136	|--------------------|----------------|
   137	| Desktop-first that "shrinks" | 60%+ traffic is mobile |
   138	| **Instead**: Design mobile-first, enhance for desktop |
   139	
   140	## Design Trend Evolution
   141	
   142	| Era | Trend |
   143	|-----|-------|
   144	| 2019-2021 | Subtle shadows, layering, dark mode |
   145	| 2022-2023 | Oversized typography, variable fonts |
   146	| 2024+ | Bento grids, claymorphism, grain, AI personalization |
   147	
   148	**Watch For** (dated patterns LLMs may suggest):
   149	- Flat design without depth
   150	- Hero sliders (proven ineffective)
   151	- Carousel galleries (low engagement)
   152	- Desktop hamburger menus
   153	
   154	## Output Deliverables
   155	
   156	1. **Brand Identity Guide**: Colors, typography, voice, do's/don'ts
   157	2. **Design Specifications**: Spacing, radius, shadows, animation timing
   158	3. **Component Examples**: Buttons, forms, cards, navigation (all states)
   159	4. **Responsive Guidelines**: Breakpoints, layout changes, touch targets
   160	
   161	## MCP Tools
   162	
   163	| Tool | Purpose |
   164	|------|---------|
   165	| `21st_magic_component_inspiration` | Search UI patterns for inspiration |
   166	| `21st_magic_component_builder` | Generate React/Tailwind components |
   167	| `21st_magic_component_refiner` | Improve existing component UI |
   168	| `logo_search` | Get company logos in JSX/TSX/SVG |
   169	
   170	## Integration with Other Skills
   171	
   172	Paired skills are bundled at `paired-skills/` in this skill directory. Read the corresponding SKILL.md when you need deeper expertise:
   173	
   174	| Skill | Path | Use For |
   175	|-------|------|---------|
   176	| **typography-expert** | `typography-expert/SKILL.md` | Deep typography decisions, font pairing, OpenType features |
   177	| **color-theory-palette-harmony-expert** | `color-theory-palette-harmony-expert/SKILL.md` | Color science, palette harmony, perceptual color spaces |
   178	| **design-system-creator** | `design-system-creator/SKILL.md` | Design tokens, CSS architecture, component libraries |
   179	| **vibe-matcher** | `vibe-matcher/SKILL.md` | Translating emotional vibes to visual DNA |
   180	| **design-archivist** | `design-archivist/SKILL.md` | Building visual databases, competitive research |
   181	
   182	## Reference Files
   183	
   184	| File | Contents |
   185	|------|----------|
   186	| `references/layout-systems.md` | Grid systems, spacing scales, responsive breakpoints |
   187	| `references/color-accessibility.md` | Palettes, psychology, dark mode, WCAG compliance |
   188	| `references/tooling-integration.md` | 21st.dev, Figma MCP, component workflows |
   189	
   190	---
   191	
   192	*The best design is invisible until you notice its excellence.*

Frequently Asked Questions

RIDE x LIFT is RedRoom's signature cycling class that combines a high-energy spin session with strength training on the floor. It's 50 minutes of total-body work set to motivating playlists in our red-lit studio.

Wear moisture-wicking athletic clothing and supportive sneakers. Cycling shoes are available at the studio but not required.

No. We provide complimentary cycling shoes at every RIDE x LIFT studio. You're welcome to bring your own SPD-compatible shoes if you prefer.

Each RIDE x LIFT class is 50 minutes — approximately 25 minutes on the bike and 25 minutes of strength work on the floor.

Absolutely. Our instructors coach every level. You control your resistance and speed, so the workout scales to your fitness level.

RIDE x LIFT is currently available at our Chelsea, NYC studio with plans to expand to additional locations.

steps.message:
The RedRoom Fitness corporate website is complete. Here's a summary of what was built:

## Output: `/app/output/`

### Files
| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `index.html` | Homepage with hero, community promo, two-ways, studio experience, free trial CTA, lifestyle carousel, newsletter, footer |
| `the-workout.html` | Workout methodology, weekly schedule table, floor/treadmill toggle, studio experience, CTA |
| `instructors.html` | Filterable instructor grid by location (All, NY, LA, London, Miami, SF) |
| `ride-faq.html` | Single-open FAQ accordion with 6 RIDE x LIFT questions |
| `digital-platform.html` | Digital platform features, workout types, unlimited access, free trial CTA |
| `css/styles.css` | Complete design system with OKLCH colors, typography, components, responsive breakpoints |
| `js/main.js` | All interactions: mobile nav, carousel, toggles, instructor filters, accordion, newsletter validation, country selector |

### Key Interactions Implemented
- **Homepage carousel** — Smooth slide transitions with prev/next arrows, touch/swipe support, dot indicators, auto-advance
- **Free trial CTA** — Visually dominant gradient band on homepage
- **Floor/Treadmill toggle** — Seamless content switch with fade animation on the-workout.html
- **Instructor location filter** — Dynamic pill-based filtering across all 5 cities with animation
- **FAQ accordion** — Single-open behavior (clicking one collapses others)
- **Newsletter validation** — Inline email format validation with success/error messages
- **Weekly schedule table** — Clean, scannable, hover-highlighted table
- **Country selector** — Dropdown in footer with 5 regions
- **Sticky nav + mobile menu** — Responsive with blur backdrop

### Design System
- **Dark mode default** (`#111`-near-black backgrounds)
- **Bold red accent** (`oklch(58% 0.24 25)`) with glow effects
- **Typography**: Oswald (display/headlines) + Inter (body)
- **Fully responsive**: mobile-first with breakpoints at 640px, 768px, 1024px
